customer: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the wider MENA region who work with several clients at once
problem: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt struggle to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
solution: A digital template pack (Notion and Google Sheets) that helps freelance graphic designers in Egypt track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
value_proposition: Bilingual Arabic and English, built for local freelancing habits, with no subscriptions that lock users in and no collection of client data.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will pay USD 100 for a digital template pack that helps them track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
hypotheses.test: Create a landing page with a one-time purchase link and track how many visitors click on the 'Buy Now' button.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will use the template pack to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
hypotheses.test: Survey 10 freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region to ask if they would use the template pack for tracking client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will prefer a bilingual (Arabic and English) template pack over one that is only in English.
hypotheses.test: Create two versions of the template pack—one in Arabic and one in English—and ask 10 freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region to choose their preferred version.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will not collect client data when using the template pack.
hypotheses.test: Survey 10 freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region to ask if they would be comfortable with the template pack not collecting client data.
